content: The pass is blocked until day 5 morning — it's day 1. So the plan: read the notice board (confirms schedule, useful info), then spend the days productively farming the meadow soil, and be positioned to head north when day 5 arrives.

args.approach: Rockslide Pass (11,4) is impassable until day 5 morning per wiki; it's day 1, so instead of wasting time pushing rocks, read the notice board for confirmation, then till/plant/water the meadow soil to pass the days, and wait near the pass so we can walk north the moment it opens.
